name: studio
note: The professional default: clean, drum-free UI sound for kinetic type and product films. Real CC0 recordings fitted as code for keys, clicks, the bamboo touch and the swish; rounded tonal pops; a warm struck tine for hero moments, tuned into the music key; air risers and breath swells. No kicks, sub thumps, sub drops or noise hats: every short sound keeps under 30 % of its energy below 150 Hz.

tick.note: a short modal tick with a small body (2.6 kHz): labels and counters, never hi-hat bright

tick.crisp.note: domino pieces knocking (a CC0 recording fitted as code): the start of a decode

tock.note: a mid-band wooden knock (400 Hz block)

hit.note: a rounded felt-struck tine over its octave: the hero lands on a warm tuned note instead of a kick

land.note: a soft rounded mid pop (550 Hz)

land.light.note: a light bamboo touch (a CC0 recording fitted as code)

pop.note: the soft pop a step higher, falling 3 st

whoosh.short.note: a real short swish (CC0 recording fitted as code); its peak lands just after the cut

whoosh.long.note: an airy gust for big transitions, no low thump

riser.note: an air build into a reveal, no sub or synth sweep

swell.note: a mid-band reverse breath, half wide

key.note: a real mechanical key, press and release (CC0 recording fitted as code)

key.space.note: a softer laptop key for spaces (no thock)

click.note: a small plastic click (CC0 recording fitted as code)

click.confirm.note: a soft wooden bar with its octave body

text.note: one soft tuned kalimba note when a line resolves
